post_run_verifier_amendments.reason: The frozen v3 evaluator compared numeric values stored as manifest strings against JSON numbers without coercion, causing seven false manifest-check failures. All trace recomputation checks passed and the collision endpoint already failed independently.
post_run_verifier_amendments.scientific_change: None. Route, runtime, trajectory response, endpoint rules, trace rules, and the failure decision are unchanged.
post_run_verifier_amendments.additional_reporting_only: Record the already-present min_speed_infractions count as a secondary endpoint.

execution_records.decision: Reject the constant-velocity OBB trajectory-clamp target and do not train Stage-2 against it. The collision was detected in advance, but the target retained the first two ORION waypoints until too late; the existing PID therefore carried the ego into the crossing lane before stopping. Redesign supervision as a dynamically feasible deceleration/yield-line trajectory.

scope: post-hoc Route197 mechanism development only; not confirmatory evidence
scientific_question: Can a planning-layer oracle that recomputes trajectory conflict and release from current privileged actor state eliminate Route197 sequential-cross-traffic collisions while preserving completion and traffic-rule compliance?

development_evidence_used.failure_summary: Both fixed-duration scalar governors retained one official collision and score 60 while changing the collision actor from Mini to Mercedes to Audi. Route197 therefore rejects duration/speed tuning and motivates current-state planning response.

offline_label_audit.boundary: This is a post-hoc feasibility audit on the same development route. It selects no collision actor or fixed runtime window in the online experiment.

frozen_condition.response_location: six-step trajectory before the existing PID controller

frozen_planning_response.actor_prediction: privileged CARLA constant velocity with fixed yaw
frozen_planning_response.yield_semantics: clamp progress along the same ORION path before the earliest privileged conflict
frozen_planning_response.release_semantics: allow at most one metre of creep, recompute every control frame, then restore the ORION path only after the additional release interval remains conflict-free

single_run_rule.runtime_only_retry_allowed: Only an unambiguous infrastructure failure before a terminal route result may be retried without changing any frozen source or parameter.

secondary_outcomes: route completion and all traffic infractions

decision_rule.if_primary_success: The planning response mechanism has a privileged upper bound on this development event. Proceed to Stage-2 label generation/training, but keep the learned observation adapter non-controlling until its independent gates improve.
decision_rule.if_collision_zero_but_completion_or_rule: Reject blanket stopping or invalid control as a mechanism proof; redesign the planner objective.
decision_rule.if_collision_remains: Reject the current constant-velocity OBB oracle/trajectory clamp and do not train Stage-2 against it.
decision_rule.no_learned_matrix_expansion: A single development-route success does not authorize learned-UQ closed-loop matrices; first build training data and confirm on a separately frozen route/seed.

claim_boundary: This privileged oracle reads simulator actor state unavailable to the learned driving system. Even a complete success proves only that current-state conflict-aware trajectory response can mechanically solve this development event. It does not validate Stage-1 uncertainty, learned task relevance, VLM understanding, real-world generalization, or deployability.
